desc: make syslog output suitable for eximstats
u: syslog2eximlog - make syslog output suitable for eximstats

syslog2eximlog converts logfiles produced by syslog when using log_file_path = syslog in your exim.conf back to exim logfile format, suitable for eximstats. syslog_timestamp may be true or false.

The program always succeeds, invalid lines will be ignored.
Please report any bugs directly to the author.
